summary: Feed rib with S = the evaluations of polynomials over the Hecke algebra and 𝒥 = the ideal generated by ℓ^ν·tr and the tie relations; this gives a Ribet element: b in the Hecke algebra and f with C(b)·f in the ideal, f without monomials properly dividing ∏X_j on 𝓧. Take s = A^k·f_o (A = ∏ u_x separates π, o = ∏X_j). Pass to the module B that l generates over the integral operators modulo ℓ^ν; by exists_tie at each place, the operators Θ_d = ∏_j (M_j or F_j) kill the image of the ideal (the family ∏(M_j + X_j F_j)), the lower terms vanish because the lifts do not move (F2), and the top term gives ℓ^ν·V(l) = c·heckeAction(A^k f_o)(y) times the unit factors; divide by ℓ^ν.
